This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="Rogue One" /> native to in [[Teres Lutha Minor]]. [[Caysin Bog]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Ultimate" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|fair]] skin<ref name="Rogue One" /> and acclimation to high-gravity environments such as their home world, [[Teres Lutha Minor]].<ref name="Ultimate" />

==Species in the galaxy==
One member of this species, [[Caysin Bog]],<ref name="Ultimate" /> was blown apart during a [[Jedha insurgency|raid]] by the [[Partisans]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> prior to [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> being saved and reconstructed as a [[cyborg]] by the [[Doctor|surgeon]] [[Cornelius Evazan]],<ref name="ROUVG" /> serving as a prototype for the [[Decraniated]],<ref name="Aphra 18">[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 18|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 18]]</ref> though he was eventually killed by rejected [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] experiments in the [[space station]] [[Hivebase-1]] around [[1 ABY]].<ref name="Death">{{Aphra2016Date|18|Caysin Bog's [[death]] aboard [[Hivebase-1]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their onscreen debut in the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', directed by [[Gareth Edwards]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> They were originally designed by creature concept designer and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]], starting off as a furry green being, but eventually losing the [[hair]].<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creatures & Character Designs|author=Manzella, Ivan|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20190121223617}}</ref>
